headline: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited acquires industrial land; Regulation 30 disclosure filed
sum: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited (MEIL) has announced the acquisition of industrial land, disclosed to NSE under SEBI Regulation 30 (material event notification).
detail: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has acquired industrial land and disclosed the transaction to the Exchange under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The disclosure indicates a material event requiring immediate notification to shareholders and the market. No acquisition price, location, area, or financing structure is disclosed in the NSE filing summary provided.
